text: Norman Mailer's The Naked and the Dead had been banned in Canada because its author had depicted sex or used profane words; the ban was reported in 1949. The book was also banned in Australia, ostensibly for its language.
meta_description: The Naked and the Dead by Norman Mailer: banned in Canada, as reported in 1949, for depicting sex or using profane words, and banned in Australia.
changes: Author leads; hedges (reported in 1949, ostensibly) kept.
